name: C++: CPA-21-02 C++ Certified Associate Programmer (C++ Institute)
material_vintage: C++ Institute CPA-21-02 exam syllabus (active; CPA-21-01 retired), fetched live on 2026-09-26 from cppinstitute.org/cpa and itemised in full: every listed topic in each of the five blocks is one item. Exam format: 40 items (single and multiple choice); 65 minutes; pass mark 70%; block weights 24.5/18/17.5/11/29%. The C++ Institute publishes no past papers: every item is original. Exam-dump sites were not used. Every code-output answer key was generated by compiling (g++, C++17) and running the code.
level_source: standalone: a vendor certification with no RQF/FHEQ level
